Changes to the Agenda
Approval of the Agenda (Action Required)
Public Comment

publicComments.name: Pam Barash
publicComments.summary: A kindergarten teacher at Henry Ford School urged the board to compensate teachers adequately so they can afford to live in the Bay Area and be retained by the district.

publicComments.name: Bree Henney
publicComments.summary: A Clifford parent expressed outrage over the hiring of a teacher with a history of inappropriate behavior and demanded full transparency about the district's hiring process and safeguards.

publicComments.name: Sarah Heder-Spack
publicComments.summary: A Clifford parent called for accountability and transparency regarding how the district hired a teacher accused of sexual harassment, and requested a retroactive review of teachers hired across the district.

publicComments.name: Josh Levinson
publicComments.summary: A Clifford parent stated he filed a formal Title IX complaint after learning from his son about ongoing inappropriate behavior by the teacher in question, and urged the district to do the hard work of addressing the issue.

publicComments.name: Jonathan Cantu
publicComments.summary: Asked the board whether it is acceptable to employ a teacher who has been fired for inappropriately touching students and what the board intends to do about it.

publicComments.name: Shauna Ingersoll
publicComments.summary: Chapter 5 President announced a student scholarship opportunity, reminded principals of the submission deadline, and highlighted the upcoming Classified Appreciation Week celebration dinner.
